_meta.project: CedarFix AI — Lebanese Arabizi Complaint Classifier

_meta.notes: telecom_eval_locked is NOT used in training — reserved for TELECOM sector evaluation only. It shares 150 rows with val by construction (see val_vs_telecom_eval_locked overlap); treat it as a val-derived diagnostic slice, not an independent holdout.

val.role: validation set (used for loss monitoring during training)

test_locked.role: LOCKED holdout — never used in training or val; final accuracy benchmark
test_locked.notes: No TELECOM rows — use telecom_eval_locked for TELECOM sector evaluation.

telecom_eval_locked.role: LOCKED TELECOM eval slice — sourced from val (0 overlap with train)

telecom_eval_locked.independence_caveat: Shares all 150 rows with val (val_vs_telecom_eval_locked = 150). Diagnostic only; NOT an independent final holdout. Rebuild from train+val-unseen rows to promote to independent eval.

overlap_proof.method: sha256 over whitespace-normalized, lowercased user message text
